note: IMD Kolkata warns of a deep depression over Gangetic West Bengal. Extremely heavy rainfall and gusty winds of 55 to 65 km/h expected over Paschim Bardhaman from 14:00.
Storm control room activated at the Asansol divisional office. Ten line gangs placed on standby.
Sustained winds of 58 km/h recorded at the Burnpur monitoring mast. Rainfall of 84 mm in six hours reported at Asansol.
First outages recorded on the 11 kV Jamuria feeder JMR-07 after a tree contact in the Nunia canal corridor.
First consumer notification issued by SMS and IVR, 38 minutes after the first recorded outage.
Outages spread across the Raniganj and Jamuria sections after waterlogging at a distribution substation.
All standby line gangs dispatched. Tree-cutting gangs mobilised to the Nunia canal corridor.
Peak consumers without supply recorded at 33,400 across 24 feeders.
Water ingress reported at the 33/11 kV Raniganj substation. Affected equipment isolated as a precaution.
Restoration underway across the Raniganj section.
Mutual aid requested from the Durgapur distribution circle.
Overnight restoration continues on the Jamuria laterals.
Durgapur circle gangs arrive on site.
Nunia canal corridor clearance underway and conductor stringing begins.
Estimated restoration times published on the consumer portal and issued by WhatsApp broadcast.
Raniganj section substantially restored.
Remaining outages are individual service connections requiring separate gang visits.
Gang visits proceeding on the remaining individual service connections.
Final consumer restored. Event closed.
The outage management system link held for the duration of the event. The manual fallback capture procedure remains undeveloped and was not exercised.
Post-event review: 14 poles, 22 spans and 5 distribution transformers replaced.
All-clear message issued to all affected service connections.
